title: Lattice vs Vibe Coding — design · write · deploy
paper: Design · Write · Deploy: Infinite Octaves Lattice Chat vs Standard Vibe Coding

honesty.note: Paired comparison using committed monorepo receipts. Cursor matrix = live provider usage. Structural comparison = chars÷4 estimate only — not marketing headline.
honesty.notClaim: Not a universal invoice SLA. Not proof that φ math alone produces savings. Open-ended tool tours can erase Lattice advantage.

design.verdict: Lattice wins design with lower context load and paired token savings

write.verdict: Lattice wins write with fewer tool calls and ~51–67% token savings

deploy.verdict: Lattice wins deploy grounding with fewer tool calls and ~52% token savings

overall.verdict: Infinite Octaves Lattice Chat beats standard vibe coding on design, write, and deploy
